name: Athanasian Creed
coreDoctrines: one God in Trinity and Trinity in unity
the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit as coequal and coeternal
Christ as fully God and fully human
Christ's saving work, resurrection, ascension, and judgment
guardsAgainst: confusing or dividing the persons of the Trinity
denying the full divinity or humanity of Christ
discernmentQuestions: Does this preserve the unity and distinction of Father, Son, and Spirit?
Does it confess Christ as fully divine and fully human?
Does it avoid flattening Christian doctrine into vague theism?
